name: What are the common challenges foreign buyers face when purchasing U.S. real estate?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges foreign buyers face when purchasing U.S. real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges include navigating unfamiliar legal and tax systems, securing financing with limited U.S. credit history, understanding currency exchange risks, and managing property from abroad. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution addresses these by providing a clear process, connecting buyers with relevant professionals, and offering virtual tours and remote transaction support, mitigating typical hurdles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foreign buyers face challenges like unfamiliar legal systems, financing without U.S. credit, and currency risks.
